facts.why: No birthday cake for Pacha's kids appears. The film's cake is the one with many candles at Mudka's when the diner sings happy birthday to a startled Yzma.

vibe.verdict: Good diner setting and plenty of Peruvian food, though the jokes lean on the same few lines.
